navigation.onboardingDescription: Review your discipline. See the evidence.
navigation.signInDescription: Sign in to access your private trading reviews.

onboarding.description: Set the defaults used to format and review your trading evidence.
onboarding.validationError: Enter a valid three-letter currency and IANA time zone.

tradeList.title: Trade list
tradeList.description: Filter trade summaries. Execution scores remain unknown until the scoring step is completed.
tradeList.emptyDescription: Adjust the filters or import trades.
tradeList.loginRequired: Connect the API login token to load your private trades.

voiceRecording.title: Voice review note
voiceRecording.permissionExplanation: Microphone access is used only while you record a private review note. Recording starts only after you tap Start.
voiceRecording.failed: The recording could not be saved.
voiceRecording.loginRequired: Recording is ready. Connect the API login token to upload.

imageUpload.title: Add screenshot evidence
imageUpload.description: Crop and compress a camera photo or library image before a private upload.
imageUpload.consent: I consent to upload this image as private trading evidence.
imageUpload.permissionDenied: Camera or photo permission was not granted.
imageUpload.ready: Image cropped and compressed. Review consent before upload.
imageUpload.loginRequired: Image is ready. Connect the API login token to upload.

tradeDetail.title: Single-trade review
tradeDetail.loginRequired: Connect a login Access Token to load this section from the detail API.
tradeDetail.scoreFormula: Total = risk-adjusted result (50) + plan target achievement (30) + outcome (20).
tradeDetail.scoreRisk: Risk adjusted: -1R to +1R maps linearly to 0–50 points.
tradeDetail.scoreTarget: Target: max(R, 0) / planned target R maps to 0–30 points.
tradeDetail.scoreOutcome: Outcome: net profit 20, breakeven 10, net loss 0.
tradeDetail.executionFormula: Execution score = passed known dimensions / all known dimensions × 100.
tradeDetail.unknownPolicy: UNKNOWN is excluded from the denominator and is never treated as a failure or zero.
tradeDetail.executionDimensions: Dimensions: rules, position, stop, plan, and observable post-loss re-entry behavior.
tradeDetail.quadrantUnknownPolicy: Breakeven, missing P&L, or incomplete rule evidence remains UNKNOWN.
tradeDetail.followUpLimit: Ask one missing-evidence question per round, for at most three rounds.
tradeDetail.followUpPlaceholderQuestion: Connect an Access Token to show the current missing-evidence question here.
tradeDetail.reviewSummaryDescription: Generate a structured summary from recorded evidence.
tradeDetail.reviewSummarySections: The summary contains overview, execution, rules, and user voice sections.
tradeDetail.reviewSummaryEvidence: Every conclusion cites execution, rule, or user voice evidence; missing evidence is stated explicitly.

preview.headline: Evidence over impulse.
preview.subtitle: Design system components and states · Dark by default
preview.emptyDescription: Import a CSV or add a screenshot to create the first review.
